edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: ‘open’ is the ordinary-knowledge antonym of ‘fail-closed’ in the context of access control, so the trailer adds nothing and should be cut.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose.
edits.reason: ‘on purpose’ and ‘by accident’ are ordinary-knowledge antonyms, so the trailer is redundant and should be cut.
